# Expected Nightly failures: `npm run test:sim` (tools/soak.ts).
#
# What this is: the exact failure lines test:sim currently produces on
# main, extracted with `grep -E '^  FAIL '` and sorted (LC_ALL=C).
# The `4 CHECK(S) FAILED` summary line is deliberately not included:
# the per-check lines already encode the count, and its format differs.
# Inspected 2026-10-20 on origin/main: these lines contain no durations,
# absolute paths, or memory figures, so no further stripping is needed;
# stable figures (win counts, code counts) are kept verbatim so a changed
# figure is a visible diff. Lines are kept verbatim, including the two
# leading spaces soak.ts prints. Comment lines starting with '#' are not
# extracted by the comparator.
#
# Green Nightly = baseline unchanged: the nightly comparator extracts the
# same lines from that night's log, sorts them the same way, and diffs
# them against the non-comment lines below. Exact match is green.
# Any difference is red: a new failure, a disappeared failure (a fix!),
# or a changed figure all show as a diff.
#
# Intentional baseline changes update this file in the same PR as the
# change that causes them. Do not edit this file to silence a diff you
# have not explained in that PR. This file does not fix or re-pin
# anything; whether to re-baseline the underlying checks is a separate
# decision.
  FAIL RA1 pinned code re-sims exactly
  FAIL RA2 pinned code re-sims exactly
  FAIL featured codes re-sim to claimed outcomes -- 32 codes
  FAIL no 1v1 regression vs pre-brain hunter -- brawler (2<4)
